functional.title: Commission and task contracts
functional.definition: Implement versioned commission authoring with environment, journey, fee and deliverable rubric pinned at publication. Bind each accepted assignment to its exact immutable brief revision.

functional.title: Tester eligibility and consent
functional.definition: Implement restricted enrollment, conflicts, scoped visibility, offer expiry and atomic assignment claims.

functional.title: Accessible evidence capture
functional.definition: Build keyboard and reader-friendly drafts, step outcomes, permitted attachments and digest-backed uploads.

functional.title: Submission and review
functional.definition: Seal revisions, validate completeness against the rubric, separate task outcome from evidence acceptance, and allow justified revision requests.

functional.title: Compensation and reconciliation
functional.definition: Create the payable exactly once, implement an approved compensation adapter and reconcile uncertain results.

functional.title: Client reporting and privacy
functional.definition: Project only consented evidence to a client report and implement redaction and retention operations.

functional.title: Retest and release comparison
functional.definition: Link follow-up commissions by defect and compare only matching task and environment dimensions.

functional.title: End-to-end agency pilot
functional.definition: Exercise a real test browser, a consenting independent tester and an agency reviewer with a restart and a redacted evidence export.

nonfunctional.title: Replayable evidence
nonfunctional.definition: A reviewer can reproduce the outcome from the exact input revision, actor scope, persisted decision and redacted evidence reference after a process restart.

invariants.title: Commission and task contracts
invariants.definition: Published briefs retain their terms for each accepted assignment.

invariants.title: Tester eligibility and consent
invariants.definition: Only one eligible, consenting tester may claim an exclusive commission.

invariants.title: Accessible evidence capture
invariants.definition: An unauthorized recording never enters the shared report.

invariants.title: Submission and review
invariants.definition: A failed task can earn acceptance of complete testing work.

invariants.title: Compensation and reconciliation
invariants.definition: One accepted assignment can create at most one external compensation intent.

invariants.title: Client reporting and privacy
invariants.definition: Each export is bound to its audience, release and report revision.

invariants.title: Retest and release comparison
invariants.definition: A previous finding never implicitly passes a later release.

invariants.title: End-to-end agency pilot
invariants.definition: Automation-only evidence cannot populate a human-observed result.
